observations: body L12: the last e of «Ptolémée» is printed broken.

body L34-L38: the comparison of the measures, continued on p. 168, is set without rules: the heads of its three columns in a smaller type, the group «Terra habitabilis» letter-spaced; the rows of dots mark the measures that a source does not give; the numbers of each column stand right-aligned, the degrees in brackets after them. The degrees convert the miles at 75 to the degree: 13 500 miles are 180°.
notes_left L2-L6: the heads of the lines are printed heavy («vel 710», «apud», «graphiques», «fors»), like bold; they are set in the type of the note.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
